persona-industrial-humanoid.reason: The official Persona AI site returned maintenance mode during collection. The manufacturer-owned page still served the product image, and the official indexed page copy identifies the industrial humanoid and its live-shop deployment.
persona-industrial-humanoid.description: Persona AI develops an industrial humanoid for skilled work in shipbuilding, construction, energy infrastructure, and fabrication. The manufacturer has demonstrated the robot performing welding work in a live shop and positions supervised teleoperation as the path toward greater autonomy.
